answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 34 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is logged against the sonnet challenge, the delta audit can replay the jetty history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2156 identities would post 5000 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
